bullets.section: What I’m doing over the weekend
bullets.title: 2022 Past Year Review
bullets.note:
I’m sometimes asked how I approach New Year’s resolutions. The truth is that I no longer approach them at all, even though I did for decades. Why? I have found “past year reviews” (PYR) more informed, valuable, and actionable than half-blindly looking forward. [Here’s the step-by-step process I follow](https://tim.blog/2021/12/27/past-year-review/?utm_source=convertkit&utm_medium=convertkit&utm_campaign=5bf).  
Pair it with **“**[**I’ve Done Tim Ferriss’s Past Year Review for 5 Years. Here Are 22 Lessons I Learned**](https://medium.com/@chriscordry/ive-done-tim-ferriss-s-past-year-review-for-5-years-here-are-22-lessons-i-learned-cfd0fb0492a1)**”** by [Chris Cordry](https://medium.com/@chriscordry).

bullets.title: The Most Vicious Heavyweight In History - Jack Dempsey
